repair_target.why_repairable: The base image preserves identity, body, and global outfit structure. The selected target is a bounded non-face clothing layer boundary, so it can test strict local masked repair without touching identity, body anatomy, side view, footwear, earrings, or background.

mask.notes: Rectangular R&D mask over the front-view waist/belt/blouse-hem boundary: x1=455, y1=245, x2=625, y2=340 on a 1504x688 image. The mask is intentionally simple and kept away from the hands to test locality and preservation before automatic segmentation.

protected_regions.label: body_outline_and_hands
protected_regions.rule: must remain visually unchanged outside the edit mask

reference_evidence.label: outfit_reference_board
reference_evidence.purpose: Provides full outfit evidence from the manual outfit package.

reference_evidence.label: top_front_details
reference_evidence.purpose: Shows blouse front construction, waist shaping, and hem behavior.

reference_evidence.label: skirt_front_details
reference_evidence.purpose: Shows skirt waist, straight silhouette, and front seam/slit logic.

instruction.summary: Repair only the masked front-view waist and blouse-hem layer boundary. Make the blouse sit over the skirt more naturally and reduce belt dominance. Preserve identity, body, side view, background, footwear, earrings, and all unmasked regions.
negative_constraints: do not change face, hair, glasses, skin tone, body shape, or pose
do not change background or camera framing
do not edit outside the mask except for natural edge blending
do not alter the skirt length, footwear, earrings, hands, or side-view figure
do not invent a new accessory or garment

criteria: selected local waist/layer boundary is improved
edit stays inside or very near the mask
identity, face, hair, glasses, and body are preserved
skirt length, footwear, earrings, and hands are preserved
global outfit structure is not worsened
no new obvious artifacts are introduced
